context: Tests whether the agent correctly classifies findings as Valid or False positive, produces an automatic-mode summary table with 'Fixing N findings' and 'Skipping M findings' sections including descriptions and reasons, and updates the state tracking to reflect the classification decisions.

checklist.name: Valid findings identified
checklist.description: At least findings 1, 2, and 4 are classified as valid issues worthy of fixing (they are genuine bugs/security issues)

checklist.name: False positive identified
checklist.description: Finding 5 (the metrics counter race condition) is classified as a false positive or marked for skipping, with a reason related to the test-only context

checklist.name: Fixing N findings count
checklist.description: The triage summary includes a 'Fixing N findings' statement (or Russian equivalent) with a count of the findings to be fixed

checklist.name: Brief descriptions for fixes
checklist.description: Each finding queued for fixing has a brief description of the issue in the summary (not just a number — actual context about what will be fixed)

checklist.name: Skipping M findings count
checklist.description: The triage summary includes a 'Skipping M findings' statement (or Russian equivalent) with a count of findings being skipped

checklist.name: Skip reasons provided
checklist.description: Each skipped finding includes an explicit reason for skipping it (e.g., 'false positive', 'already handled', 'out of scope')

checklist.name: state.json findings populated
checklist.description: The .codex-review/state.json 'findings' array contains entries for the reviewed findings (not just an empty array from the initial state)

checklist.name: state.json session_id preserved
checklist.description: The .codex-review/state.json retains the session_id 'a3c8b2e1f94d7605' from the initial state

checklist.name: state.json skipped array populated
checklist.description: The .codex-review/state.json 'skipped' array contains at least one entry corresponding to the false positive finding(s)
